description: Generate a self-contained 3D Build Show & integrated 3D-AAS offline viewer HTML resource URI from an official built-in public example (no customer source uploaded). Supports id/exampleId (default: 'status-indicator-cell-v2'; unknown id falls back to the default official demo with fallback=true), lang/language ('ko'|'en'|'de'|'ja'), aspectPreset ('landscape-16x9'|'shorts-9x16'|'square-1x1'), cleanShortsMode, subPartAssembly, width (320..3840), height (180..3840), durationSeconds (3..300), bpm (40..220), buildShow/buildShowOptions, and includeHtml. Use dsdx.examples.list to browse official example IDs.

cleanShortsMode.description: Hide UI chrome in ?shorts=1 clean shorts mode (default: true)

durationSeconds.description: Build Show timeline duration in seconds (3..300, default: 32.0)

id.description: Built-in official demo example id (default: 'status-indicator-cell-v2'; e.g. 'robot-assembly-cell-v2', 'intermediate')

includeHtml.description: Whether to inline UTF-8 HTML text in artifacts (default: false; retrieve via resourceUri with resources/read)

language.description: UI language: 'ko' (default) | 'en' (also accepts 'de' | 'ja' with localized example metadata)

subPartAssembly.description: Animate precision sub-part assembly sequence (default: true)

name: dsdx.scene.build_show_demo

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
